disposition_reason: Table 3 prints As, Cd, Hg and Pb in 32 canned meat products sampled across storage times; Tables 5-6 give ingredient lots and Table 7 per-product means.

study.design: storage study of canned military meat products sampled at storage times up to 6 years, plus ingredient lots
study.origin: produced in Serbia by six contracted industrial producers (A-F) to military standards
study.period_text: storage periods 0/1 to 6/0 years/months; calendar dates not reported
study.qa: BCR-185R recoveries As 106.2%, Cd 100.9%, Pb 100.8% (Table 1); NIST 1577c in each series; Hg spike recoveries 93.5-106.0%
